label: No. 05 · 06 · 07 · Craftsmanship
title: The Art of… Books, by Hand
subtitle: To keep, and to last for generations
image_alt: Oil painting of the bookbinding workshop with an old Bible, a diary and a wedding book
intro: Old books you would love to preserve? Old Bibles, recipe books, history books, or just old books you love — in need of a new cover or binding? We repair them.
more: And for those who love to own one, we craft diaries and wedding books with the elements of nature. Not just a book: an expression of art, for you to keep and to last.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.text: Share your ideas — or pictures and video of the book that needs repair.

steps.title: We take a look
steps.text: From the pictures or video we determine if we can help you.

steps.title: Give us some time
steps.text: It is a craft. Craft takes patience.

steps.title: Back to you
steps.text: Your book comes back by express, with track & trace.

cta_text: Give us the opportunity to create something that lasts for generations.
